name: Sophia's Thai
description: Sophia's Thai set (2026-10-08): two Shehds 3W lasers + the OK103 wash bar behind the DJ stand, nothing else. laser_profile=show runs the lasers lit for the whole set on a picked scene (engines/laser_show.py, the console's Laser Show tab); the bar runs Synth Sync exactly as before. Addressing reused from bar_rig.json: wash bar 1-6, Laser L 7-18, Laser R 19-30 (12-channel mode on each laser).

slots.label: Wash Bar
slots.mount_note: Behind the DJ stand. Set the unit to address 1 (6-channel mode).
